3D Modelling
Babbling with Baobabs
A 2.1-metre carved baobab, lit and projection-mapped, built for Oddtoe's children's show at the Melbourne International Comedy Festival.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
3D Modelling
3D Sculpture Project
Sculpture design case study of Oddtoe's limited edition, "Roman General with Pinkeye".
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Animation
The Oddtoe TV Show
See a lost-in-time, satirical newscast from Australia. Shoddy journalism and off-color commercials pepper this modern piss-take of today's media.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Comedic Writing
The Jackalope Factory
The calamitous story of the world's most beloved taxidermist is told in this comedic novella.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
3D Modelling
Stained Glass Window Project
A church renovation with a sense of humor.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Animation
Wire Taps TV Show
In the future, our AI bot overlords entertain us with TV soap operas of humanities' conversations, secretly recorded since the Y2K bug.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Garden Design
Topiary Design: The Garden Park Project
See a topiarist's vision for a semi-arid topiary garden.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Animation
Date Night Confessionals TV Show
Date Night Confessionals is an animated web series visualizing & narrating the most awkward dating stories. Cringe, gawk & feel superior.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Comic Art
Gag Cartoonist
The comic panel, Oddtoe, a gag cartoon unique in the world.
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/6″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
AI Animation Examples
Atheism Documentary
See a new animation workflow via a documentary about atheism. Generative AI, motion design, & a keen sense of visual storytelling.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]
Illustration
Visualize!
Visualize anything with this training workshop from Oddtoe & the Datalabs Agency.
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/6″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
